description: B2B database schema + RLS for the core relational model: CA Firms (accounts), Contacts (many per firm), B2B Leads/Prospects, Import Batches, Activities, Follow-ups, Partnerships, Referrals, and a configurable B2B sources table. This is the server-side data + permission foundation. All tables additive, all RLS enforced server-side (admin full access; B2B users limited to records assigned to them). Also provides the typed data-access layer (hand-written row types + query helpers) that every UI phase consumes. No UI pages beyond what FEAT-001 stubbed.
steps: Author migration supabase/migrations/20260517000002_b2b_core.sql (idempotent) creating these tables with sensible columns, FKs, indexes, updated_at triggers (reuse a touch_updated_at trigger fn pattern like hrms_touch_updated_at), and RLS. Tables: (1) ca_firms — id, firm_name, firm_type, firm_size, website, phone, alt_phone, email, city, state, full_address, lead_source, source_url, partner_status (health category), partner_since date, owner/assigned_to uuid -> profiles, primary_contact_id uuid, import_batch_id uuid, partner_score numeric, created_by, created_at, updated_at. (2) b2b_contacts — id, firm_id -> ca_firms ON DELETE CASCADE, name, designation, phone, alt_phone, email, is_primary bool, created_by, timestamps. (3) b2b_leads — the prospecting record: id, b2b_lead_code (human id), firm_id -> ca_firms (nullable; a lead may precede firm creation), contact_person, designation, phone, alt_phone, email, website, city, state, full_address, firm_type, firm_size, lead_source, source_url, assigned_to uuid, lead_status text (default 'new_prospect'), priority, last_contacted_at, next_follow_up_at, latest_remark, follow_up_count int default 0, created_by, import_batch_id, timestamps. (4) b2b_import_batches — id, source, file_name, uploaded_by, total_records, new_records, duplicate_records, invalid_records, assigned_records, created_at. (5) b2b_activities — id, firm_id, contact_id, lead_id (any may be null but at least one set), type text (call/whatsapp/email/meeting/task/followup/note), subject, body/notes, outcome, duration_minutes, happened_at, created_by, created_at; append-friendly for the timeline. (6) b2b_followups — id, lead_id/firm_id, due_at, status (pending/done/missed), remark, completed_at, created_by, assigned_to, timestamps. (7) partnerships — id, firm_id -> ca_firms, stage text (pipeline stage), status (open/won/lost), outcome_reason, value numeric, assigned_to, opened_at, closed_at, timestamps. (8) referrals — id, referral_code, firm_id -> ca_firms, referring_contact_id -> b2b_contacts, referred_client_name, client_phone, date_received, assigned_salesperson uuid, service_required, referral_status text (new/assigned/contacted/qualified/converted/lost/invalid), converted bool, lead_id uuid -> public.leads (nullable, links referral to a Sales Lead), booking_id uuid -> public.bookings (nullable, links to Booking), booking_value numeric, revenue numeric, referral_date, converted_date, notes, created_by, timestamps. (9) b2b_sources — id, name, active, created_at (configurable source list; seed with Google, Google Maps, CA Directory, Website, Referral, LinkedIn, Other via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).

Add FKs expressing the required relationships from spec section 26: ca_firms->contacts, ca_firms->activities, ca_firms->partnerships, ca_firms->referrals, referrals->leads (public.leads), referrals->bookings (public.bookings). Use ON DELETE SET NULL for cross-module links (leads/bookings) so deleting a Sales lead/booking never destroys B2B history; ON DELETE CASCADE only for firm->contacts.

Enable RLS on every new table. Policies mirror the HRMS/leads pattern using existing helpers public.is_admin(auth.uid()) and public.has_role(auth.uid(),'b2b'): admin = full CRUD on all rows. B2B users = SELECT/UPDATE on rows where assigned_to/assigned_salesperson = auth.uid() OR created_by = auth.uid() OR (for firms) owner = auth.uid(); INSERT allowed for b2b role with WITH CHECK created_by = auth.uid(); contacts/activities/followups inherit access via their parent firm/lead ownership (join in the USING clause or match assigned/created). b2b_sources: SELECT to all authenticated, write admin-only. b2b_import_batches: SELECT own-or-admin, INSERT self. Add explicit comments that RLS is the real boundary (frontend hiding is cosmetic). Keep all policies DROP POLICY IF EXISTS ... then CREATE.

Add indexes on all FK columns and on b2b_leads(assigned_to), b2b_leads(lead_status), b2b_leads(next_follow_up_at), referrals(referral_status), ca_firms(assigned_to), ca_firms(partner_status), b2b_activities(firm_id,happened_at).

Fill in src/lib/b2b.ts (or src/lib/b2b-db.ts) with hand-written TypeScript row types for every table above (CaFirm, B2BContact, B2BLead, B2BImportBatch, B2BActivity, B2BFollowup, Partnership, Referral, B2BSource) matching the migration columns exactly, plus the b2bDb() cast helper from FEAT-001. These types are the contract since generated types.ts cannot be regenerated.

Create src/lib/b2b-queries.ts with thin typed query helpers used by later UI phases (e.g. listFirms, getFirm360(id) aggregating contacts+activities+partnerships+referrals+totals, listB2BLeads(filters), listReferrals, listFollowups(scope), createActivity, updateFollowup). Keep business/aggregation maths that is pure (e.g. partner score, funnel counts) in separate testable functions.

Create src/lib/b2b-scoring.ts (pure) with partnerScore() and partnerHealthCategory() derived from referrals/bookings/revenue/last-contact recency, and add src/lib/b2b-scoring.test.ts covering the thresholds and edge cases (no referrals -> Potential/Dormant, recent referrals -> Active/Strategic, long inactivity -> Dormant/Lost).
This phase ships no new user-visible pages (the FEAT-001 stub stays). Verify everything typechecks/builds. Run prettier on new files.
acceptance_criteria: Migration 20260517000002_b2b_core.sql creates all 9 tables idempotently with FKs, indexes, updated_at triggers and RLS enabling + policies using is_admin/has_role('b2b').
Cross-module FKs to public.leads and public.bookings use ON DELETE SET NULL; firm->contacts uses ON DELETE CASCADE.
src/lib/b2b.ts / b2b-db.ts export accurate hand-written row types for all tables plus b2bDb(); src/lib/b2b-queries.ts compiles.
src/lib/b2b-scoring.ts pure functions are covered by b2b-scoring.test.ts and all tests pass.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` green, `bun run build` succeeds.
No existing table or migration was altered.
verification: Manually re-read 20260517000002_b2b_core.sql to confirm every table ENABLEs RLS and has at least one admin-full and one owner-scoped policy, and that no existing table is referenced destructively.
